user.description: Automatically discover Govee lights on your network, or turn discovery off and add each light yourself by IP address.

cannot_start.message: Could not start listening for Govee lights: {error}

device_still_online.message: {name} is still responding on your network, so it would be discovered again immediately. Turn the light off or disconnect it from your network, wait a minute, then try again. To stop tracking a manually added light, use Configure > Remove a device instead.

no_source_ips.message: No IPv4 network interfaces are enabled for Home Assistant to listen on. Enable at least one in Settings > System > Network.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Govee lights local configuration entry is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_devices: No manually added devices were found

error.invalid_ip: {ip} is not a valid IP address

remove_device.description: Select one or more IP addresses to remove
